title: 雲の上の修理屋と、止まった時間のおやつ
author: 白湯 ぬくみ

en.title: The Repair Shop Above the Clouds and the Treats of Frozen Time
en.premise: On a tiny island floating amidst the breaks in the clouds, an elderly woman runs a "Sky Repair Shop," mending broken tools. Her workshop is always filled with the scent of well-worn instruments and the fragrant aroma of baking wheat. One day, she receives a pocket watch whose hands have stopped after losing its owner, along with a small model of a flying ship. By facing these broken objects and carefully setting their time in motion once more, she begins to gently restart the hearts of those who had long since stood still.

zh.title: 云端上的修理铺与停滞时光的点心
zh.premise: 在云隙间漂浮的小岛上，有一位经营着“天空修理铺”、专门修补破损工具的老妇人。她的身边总是环绕着用旧的工具，以及阵阵麦香。某一天，一个失去了主人、指针停滞的怀表，以及一艘小小的飞行船模型被送到了她的手中。通过面对这些破碎之物，并细心地让它们重新开始走动，那些曾一度停滞不前的归属者的心，也随之一点点重新律动了起来。
